title: 06 · kama · Kama's One Arrow
lines: The god of love once shot an arrow at Shiva.
He only ever got to fire one.
and only a son of Shiva could end him.
and sat frozen in grief. He wanted no one.
Parvati served him every day. He never opened his eyes.
One arrow. Make him look at her.
"One arrow. Make him look at her."
Spring came to the frozen mountain.
And for one breath, he was moved.
Then he looked for who had done this to him.
One glance from the third eye.
But for her own fire. Not for an arrow.
What is forced on you is not love. What you choose is. That is sadhana.
